The '''Subjugation of Sinton'''<ref name="Darksaber" /> was an event that occurred during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]],<ref name="Dagobah Limited" /> specifically at some point by [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].<ref name="Sinton date" /> During the event, the<ref name="Dagobah Limited" /> [[High Human Culture/Legends|Humanocentric]]<ref name="CSWE-Human High Culture">{{CSWECite|II|66|Human High Culture}}</ref> Empire subjugated the<ref name="Dagobah Limited" /> [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="The Essential Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Sinton system/Legends|Sinton system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sinton]], which was populated by [[Alien/Legends|non-Humans]]. Imperial personnel participating in the operation included [[Ardan]]<ref name="Dagobah Limited" /> and, allegedly, [[Sulamar]].<ref name="Darksaber" />

By [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]],<ref name="Essential Reader's Companion">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> Sulamar, a low-level Imperial [[Technician/Legends|technician]] who falsely titled himself a [[General/Legends|general]], regularly adorned his [[Imperial military uniforms/Legends|uniform]] with many medals from previous campaigns he claimed he had won. Sulamar constantly boasted of his [[Imperial Military/Legends|military]] exploits<ref name="Darksaber" />&mdash;some nonexistent<ref name="CSWE-Sulamar">{{CSWECite|III|195|Sulamar, General}}</ref>&mdash;which he alleged included the Subjugation of Sinton. In reality, Sulamar was but a career military failure.<ref name="Darksaber" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Subjugation of Sinton was first mentioned in the [[1995]] novel [[Darksaber (novel)|''Darksaber'']], written by [[Kevin J. Anderson]]. The character Imperial General Sulamar brags of his military exploits, which include the Subjugation of Sinton, throughout the story until he is eventually exposed as a fraud, leaving in doubt whether he was involved in the event&mdash;and, indeed, whether that event even occurred at all.<ref name="Darksaber" /> The Subjugation of Sinton was later mentioned, and thereby established as factual, on the [http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Dagobah-Dark/large/lieutenantcommanderardan.gif "Lieutenant Commander Ardan" card] as part of the [[1997]] ''[[Dagobah Limited]]'' expansion set of the [[Decipher]] [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]].<ref name="Dagobah Limited" />
